newsitem.title: USA: LXR Biotechnology says McGuire ups stake.
newsitem.headline: LXR Biotechnology says McGuire ups stake.

text.p: LXR Biotechnology said Wednesday that Kenneth McGuire has increased his holdings in the company from 9.3 percent to 18.4 percent.
In private transactions, the company said, McGuire purchased 1,974,000 shares of common stock from Biotechnology Investment Group Llc and certain trusts.
McGuire is a private investor with principal stockholder position in a number of biotechnology companies.

"We welcome Ken McGuire's purchases of our stock," said Dr. L. David Tomei, chief executive officer of LXR. "Ken has been very supportive of our company over the past year, and we look forward to working closely with him as we move ahead."
